rm -f /data/tk048/chain64.done /data/tk048/chain64.txt
H=/data/tk046/jan/home; E=$H/alpha/epochs/e-jan; C=/data/tk048/colE; D=2026-01-01

  for x in $E/study/*; do b=$(basename $x); [ "$b" = root-$D ] || ln -s $x $C/study/$b; done

fi
